items.headline: Acne Studios' best jeans, 30 years on
items.caption: The brand began with 100 pairs of raw denim.
body: Its trompe-l'oeil jeans fake a worn-in look.
Acne still nails denim three decades later.
How to wear it: with a plain grey sweatshirt.

items.headline: Ralph Lauren chinos that come already worn
items.caption: Faded, distressed and repaired, straight off the shelf.
body: Part of Highsnobiety's 'One Good' series.
They look like someone loved them for years.
How to wear it: with an oxford shirt and loafers.

items.headline: Why every sneaker is turning into a derby
items.caption: Highsnobiety's guide to the lace-up shoe taking over.
body: From Dr. Martens 1461s to Paraboot Michaels.
Most men already own a derby.
How to wear it: chunky derbies with wide trousers.

items.headline: What Jensen Huang's leather jacket says now
items.caption: A column on how his look went from cool to 'bad boy'.
body: It traces the leather jacket back to Marlon Brando.
The scandal changed how people read his uniform.
Style lesson: a signature look tells a story.

items.headline: JJJJound gives Danner's hiking boot a menswear makeover
items.caption: The pair reunite on the Mountain Light after five years.
body: Danner is a 94-year-old American bootmaker.
This version is built to go with big trousers.
How to wear it: with wide-leg trousers and a fleece.

items.headline: Every Levi's jean number that matters, explained
items.caption: GQ's fit guide from the 501 to the 568.
body: There's a cut for every body.
Levi's is still the reference for jeans.
How to wear it: find your fit, then buy two.

items.headline: How to build a David Beckham-worthy coat collection
items.caption: From Matrix-era leather trenches to a £5k Loro Piana overcoat.
body: Esquire picks his best outerwear moments.
Plus options at every budget.
How to wear it: one great camel overcoat first.

items.headline: Jensen Huang's viral studded jacket was a fake
items.caption: The internet loved his wild Saint Laurent look. It wasn't real.
body: The image spread as Nvidia faced its scandal.
Esquire says it was fabricated.
Style lesson: check before you share.

items.headline: TAG Heuer x Time+Tide 'Sundowner II'
items.caption: Rose gold meets sandblasted titanium on a new Aquaracer.
body: The first Sundowner's 250 pieces sold out in a day.
This is the sequel.
Style lesson: warm metal softens a sporty watch.

items.headline: Krayon's 'Magnolia' sunrise-sunset watch
items.caption: A 15-piece run inspired by spring in Neuchâtel.
body: Krayon makes just three complicated models.
Founder Remi Maillat designs its unusual movements.
Style lesson: rare watches make the best stories.

items.headline: 280 Ice Age cave engravings found hiding in plain sight
items.caption: Visitors walked past them for decades in a Spanish cave.
body: It's the third-largest set on Spain's Mediterranean side.
Some visitors had even carved names over them.

items.headline: Spain's brown bears have doubled in 20 years
items.caption: Cantabrian brown bears rose from about 140 to 370.
body: They now roam over 17,000 square kilometres.
Protection efforts brought them back from the brink.

items.headline: Once paralysed, she came back to play piano for patients
items.caption: 84-year-old Bonnie Fay kept her promise to the rehab centre that helped her.
body: Guillain-Barré syndrome had left her paralysed.
Now she plays for patients at Bryn Mawr Village.
